meta.name: ecommerce-seller-info
meta.description: Extract seller or merchant profile data from marketplace platform seller pages. Returns seller name, rating, review count, positive feedback percentage, joined date, and return policy. Works on Amazon seller pages, eBay seller pages, and any e-commerce site with seller profiles. Use when: seller information, merchant profile, seller rating, marketplace seller data, seller details, vendor profile, store information, seller feedback, merchant rating, seller review count, get seller info, ebay seller page, amazon seller profile, marketplace vendor analysis, seller research.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 提取电商卖家资料，包括评分、评价和政策
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在电商平台快速了解卖家背景和信誉
copy.tagline_en: Extract seller profiles with ratings, reviews, and policies
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly assess seller credibility on marketplaces

howto.what: 当你在浏览器中打开电商卖家页面时，它能提取卖家名称、评分、评价数、好评率、加入日期和退货政策等信息。
howto.when: 当你访问亚马逊、eBay等电商平台的卖家页面，或要求获取卖家信息时触发。

say.text: 帮我查一下这个亚马逊卖家的评分和评价数。
say.note: 提取当前卖家页面的评分和评价数。

say.text: 看看这个eBay卖家的好评率和加入日期。
say.note: 提取eBay卖家页面的好评率和加入日期。

howto.what_en: When you open an e-commerce seller page in your browser, it extracts seller name, rating, review count, positive feedback percentage, joined date, and return policy.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you visit seller pages on Amazon, eBay, or other e-commerce sites, or when you ask for seller information.

say_en.text: Check this Amazon seller's rating and review count.
say_en.note: Extracts rating and review count from the current seller page.

say_en.text: Look up this eBay seller's positive feedback and join date.
say_en.note: Extracts positive feedback percentage and join date from the eBay seller page.
